title: "Interactive University Acceptance Model"
format: html

### Linear Decision Boundary

The equation $w_1(\text{Test}) + w_2(\text{Grades}) + b = 0$ separates the accepted (blue) from the rejected (red).

<div dir="ltr">

```{ojs}
// 1. INPUTS
viewof w1 = Inputs.range([-5, 5], {value: 2.0, step: 0.1, label: "w₁ (Test Weight)"})
viewof w2 = Inputs.range([-5, 5], {value: 1.5, step: 0.1, label: "w₂ (Grade Weight)"})
viewof b  = Inputs.range([-50, 50], {value: -25, step: 0.5, label: "b (Bias/Threshold)"})

// 2. DATA GENERATION (Fixed Scatter)
data = {
  const random = d3.randomLcg(42);
  return Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
    x1: random() * 10,
    x2: random() * 10
  }));
}

// 3. VISUALIZATION
{
  const width = 600;
  const height = 450;
  const margin = {top: 20, right: 30, bottom: 40, left: 50};

  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 10]).range([margin.left, width - margin.right]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 10]).range([height - margin.bottom, margin.top]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto; font-family: sans-serif;");

  // Axes
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - margin.bottom})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(x))
    .call(g => g.append("text")
      .attr("x", width - margin.right)
      .attr("y", -6)
      .attr("fill", "currentColor")
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .text("TEST SCORE (x1)"));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},0)`)
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y))
    .call(g => g.append("text")
      .attr("x", 6)
      .attr("y", margin.top)
      .attr("fill", "currentColor")
      .attr("text-anchor", "start")
      .attr("font-weight", "bold")
      .text("GRADES (x2)"));

  // Points: Color based on the current line parameters
  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(data)
    .join("circle")
      .attr("cx", d => x(d.x1))
      .attr("cy", d => y(d.x2))
      .attr("r", 4)
      .attr("fill", d => (w1 * d.x1 + w2 * d.x2 + b > 0) ? "#4f46e5" : "#ef4444")
      .attr("opacity", 0.7);

  // Decision Boundary Line
  // Rearranged: x2 = (-w1*x1 - b) / w2
  let x1_0 = 0, x1_10 = 10;
  let x2_0, x2_10;

  if (Math.abs(w2) > 0.01) {
    x2_0 = (-w1 * x1_0 - b) / w2;
    x2_10 = (-w1 * x1_10 - b) / w2;
    
    svg.append("line")
      .attr("x1", x(x1_0))
      .attr("y1", y(x2_0))
      .attr("x2", x(x1_10))
      .attr("y2", y(x2_10))
      .attr("stroke", "black")
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray", "4");
  } else {
    // Vertical line: x1 = -b/w1
    const x_vert = -b / w1;
    svg.append("line")
      .attr("x1", x(x_vert))
      .attr("y1", y(0))
      .attr("x2", x(x_vert))
      .attr("y2", y(10))
      .attr("stroke", "black")
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray", "4");
  }

  return svg.node();
}
```

</div>
